mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trade(account_id, stock_code, trade_type, quantity, price, fee) VALUES(#{accountId}, #{stockCode}, #{tradeType}, #{quantity}, #{price}, #{fee})
mapper.select: SELECT t.trade_id, t.account_id, t.stock_code, s.stock_name, t.trade_type, t.quantity, t.price, t.fee, t.trade_at FROM trade t JOIN stock s ON t.stock_code = s.stock_code WHERE t.account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY t.trade_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trade(account_id, stock_code, trade_type, quantity, price, fee, trade_at) VALUES(#{accountId}, #{stockCode}, #{tradeType}, #{quantity}, #{price}, #{fee}, #{tradeAt})
mapper.select: SELECT t.trade_id, t.account_id, t.stock_code, s.stock_name, t.trade_type, t.quantity, t.price, t.fee, t.trade_at FROM trade t JOIN stock s ON t.stock_code = s.stock_code JOIN account_link al ON t.account_id = al.account_id WHERE al.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY t.trade_at DESC
